chapters.text: Pinch a seed. Carry it over the glowing bowl, then open your fingers to plant it. Does controlling this hand make it yours?

captions.text: Carry it over the glowing bowl, then open your fingers to plant it.
Does controlling this hand make it yours?

chapters.text: Point your index finger and draw a ribbon of light. Does this feel like your hand, or something you control?

chapters.text: Bring both open hands close together and hold. Watch the mandala and your changing hands. When the form changes, does the sense of mine change?

chapters.text: Let your hands rest. Notice your hand, then the thought, my hand. What is aware of both?
